name: gawainbook
description: GawainBook: a social network for book lovers (React + Express + Neon Postgres).

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix react-frontend ci --legacy-peer-deps && npm --prefix Node-Rest-API ci
scripts.build:frontend: cd react-frontend && npx -y -p node@16 node node_modules/react-scripts/bin/react-scripts.js build
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.test:frontend: cd react-frontend && npx -y -p node@16 node node_modules/react-scripts/bin/react-scripts.js test --watchAll=false
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
